name: MuJoCo Rollout Dataset
purpose: A local pipeline that rolls out reinforcement-learning policies in MuJoCo Playground, renders each episode to video, and streams the rendered video plus per-step state, action and reward arrays and an episode-summary JSON to Backblaze B2 for offline policy analysis and behavioral-cloning dataset curation.
tagline: Roll out simulated robots, stream the dataset straight to B2.

features.title: Rollout Configuration
features.summary: create, edit, list and delete rollout jobs (environment, episode count, resolution, camera, policy)

features.title: Policy Rollout & Rendering
features.summary: MuJoCo Playground rolls out a policy, records state/action/reward, and renders each episode to MP4 — runs locally, CPU by default

features.title: B2 Dataset Write
features.summary: per episode: MP4 + state/action/reward .npy + summary JSON streamed to B2

features.title: Dataset Explorer
features.summary: browse rollouts and episodes, play rendered video and download trajectory arrays via presigned URLs

features.title: Bucket Explorer
features.summary: browse the full B2 bucket: list, preview, download, delete

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: rollout and episode stats, cumulative reward, storage used, recent rollouts

b2_surface.why: write rollout config JSON, rendered episode MP4, state/action/reward .npy arrays, and episode-summary JSON
list rollouts and episodes under the rollouts/ prefix, and back the full-bucket explorer and dashboard stats
the /health connectivity probe and cheap per-asset existence and size checks
re-read episode-summary JSON and small arrays server-side
inline playback of rendered MP4 and download of trajectory .npy arrays
delete a rollout and every artifact under its prefix

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, Pydantic v2, MuJoCo Playground (mujoco + mujoco-mjx + jax), imageio

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**) — shown once at creation

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: separate-origin deploys only; Next.js inlines it at build time
